canonical_project: Anant Raj Cloud - Rai hyperscale data centre campus
notes: Official Anant Raj page: 'Anant Raj Cloud has commenced its data center expansion at Rai' (Sonipat district). Company news: Rai has potential for 200 MW data centre. Livemint: Anant Raj plans to expand DC capacity from 28 MW (FY26) to 63 MW by FY27 and ~307 MW by FY32. 200 MW is planned full-buildout capacity, not current IT load.
